texts.How do you personally use cryptocurrency: I have worked in crypto daily since 2017. At Everex (Singapore) I wrote smart contracts and led government and bank relations across SE Asia on structuring crypto payments and stablecoins, and I designed one of the first detailed frameworks for a national government to issue its own stablecoins. At Platinum VC & Incubator our portfolio is ~70% crypto; I shipped crypto-exchange infrastructure (backends, market-maker engines, HFT systems) and have fundraised in crypto since 2017 ($35M fund, syndicate of 250 VCs/angels). Personally I use crypto for cross-border payments and settlement between the US, EU and APAC. What keeps me interested is programmable money: stablecoins and on-chain settlement remove friction that traditional rails cannot - and tools like CoinTracker are what make that usable (and tax-reportable) for normal people.
texts.What are your goals for your next role: I want to own a growth/GTM problem end-to-end inside a focused product team, rather than across a portfolio. My default mode is launching from scratch: 10+ years as a venture founder, I own problem framing, funnel design, evaluation and GTM while engineers (human or AI) implement. My current proof is a production multi-machine Claude fleet (6 machines) with 100+ automation routines that I run in public. My goal is to combine that AI-agent automation with a decade of crypto depth in a company where growth is measured and shipped weekly - CoinTracker sits exactly at that intersection of crypto and consumer product.
